description: Three oscillators, each fading between four waves and carrying its own level and output, with all three mixed at the main output

params.text: In one position the second oscillator takes the first oscillator's pitch input; in the other it uses its own jack
In one position the third oscillator takes the second oscillator's pitch input; in the other it uses its own jack
Sets that oscillator's character: analogue drifts in tune and softens the corners of the wave, digital does neither
Chooses what a signal at the sync input does: hard sync restarts the cycle, soft sync reverses it instead
Fades that oscillator between its sine and triangle blend and its sawtooth and square blend
Fades the third oscillator between its sine and triangle blend and its square wave
Sets that oscillator's pitch in semitones, four and a half octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Tunes that oscillator by up to three semitones either way
Sets how far the FM input moves that oscillator's pitch
Sets the level of that oscillator, at its own output and in the main mix
Fades that oscillator between a sine at the bottom and a triangle at the top
Fades that oscillator between a sawtooth at the bottom and a square at the top
Sets the width of the third oscillator's square wave

inputs.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch, a volt to the octave
Resets that oscillator's cycle, hard or soft as its switch is set
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the third oscillator is synced from the first oscillator's sync jack
Modulates that oscillator's pitch by the octave, attenuated by its FM knob
Scales the wave fade of that oscillator, 10V leaving it at the slider setting and 0V returning it to the sine and triangle blend
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the second oscillator's wave fade is scaled by the first oscillator's wave mix CV jack
Scales that oscillator's level, 10V leaving it at the knob setting and 0V silencing it
Moves the width of the third oscillator's square wave, scaled by the PWM knob

outputs.text: That oscillator on its own, reaching 5V with its level knob fully open
The three oscillators mixed, clamped between -5V and 5V

notes: the three level knobs start at zero, so a new module is silent; raise an oscillator's level knob to hear it at its own output and in the mix
every output carries one channel, so a polyphonic voltage at a pitch input is read but only its first channel reaches the outputs
